name: John Boozman

issue_poll.name: Arkansas Poll (University of Arkansas), Oct 13–31, 2022; plus Pew Research Center, Oct 10–16, 2022
issue_poll.note: Ranks 1–5 come from the Arkansas Poll's most-important-problem question (economy 39%, drugs 10%, education 8%, health care 7%, taxes/big government 7%; 'politicians/politics' dropped because no vote can test it). That question offered only a few options, so ranks 6–10 come from national Pew 'very important' shares (energy 61%, violent crime 61%, elections/voting 58%, gun policy 57%, abortion 56%). 'Future of democracy' was dropped as untestable, and immigration (54%) fell just outside the top 10. Pew source: https://www.pewresearch.org/wp-content/uploads/sites/20/2022/10/PP_2022.10.20_midterms-economy_REPORT.pdf

issues.position: Curb inflation by stopping new federal spending (no specific measure named)
Release people federally jailed for simple marijuana possession; expunge records
issues.note: No Senate floor vote on marijuana-possession release or expungement this term.

votes.bill_title: Disapproval of the student loan debt relief rule (CRA)
votes.question: On passage

issues.position: Improve veterans' health care access (no forward-looking measure; PACT Act passed in 2022)
Oppose tax increases on businesses and IRS expansion
issues.note: H.R.1 extended the 2017 tax cuts and rescinded some IRS funding.

issues.position: Allow Keystone XL; reopen federal lands to energy development
issues.note: H.R.1 required federal onshore and offshore oil and gas lease sales; Keystone XL got no vote.

issues.position: Keep state voter ID laws; oppose federal control of elections; keep filibuster
issues.note: Democratic federal voting bills got no floor vote; his SAVE America Act Yea (RC 57, 2026) cuts both ways.

issues.position: Overturn Biden ATF firearm rules; oppose new gun-control laws

votes.bill_title: Disapproval of ATF pistol stabilizing brace rule (CRA)
votes.question: On the joint resolution

issues.position: Oppose abortion except rape, incest, mother's life; no federal funding

votes.question: Cloture on the motion to proceed

caveats: Issue ranks 6–10 rely on national Pew data because the Arkansas Poll offered only a short list of problems; immigration, his main primary-ad theme, ranked 11th.
Elections left unscored: the SAVE America Act fits his voter-ID stance but is a federal election mandate, which he said he opposed.
Gun vote tests a different ATF rule (pistol braces) than the 2022 frame/receiver rule he named; Boozman's Yea there is inferred from usquery list counts, and RC 171 comes from third-party trackers.
His 2022 campaign issues page (boozmanforarkansas.com/issues) could not be fetched, so positions come from debate coverage, ads and Senate releases.
